flow: manual offline permanent project cleanup and resume
acceptance: Only the owner can request permanent deletion of a trashed project with its exact name and current version; purging is irreversible and incomplete cleanup is reported honestly.
Offline maintenance proves normal writer processes have exited and all admitted work is settled; a persistent gate refuses new startup and survives a maintenance crash.
A verified owned manifest is fixed before deletion, and other projects, referenced shared content, global settings, credentials, original imports, external repositories and backups are retained.
Cleanup progress survives failure and restart; explicit resume continues the same plan, and completion retains only a minimal receipt with no project research content.
Isolated process contention, unpublished CAS preparation, crash/resume, resource preservation and confirmation/status UI checks provide evidence for the core path.
design_decisions: Normal process occupancy lasts until OS process exit, not Store.close; only an unambiguous ESRCH permits removal.
Maintenance permission is a process-local opaque capability backed by a persistent gate; no force unlock or lease-time expiry bypass.
Backup creation participates as a shared writer occupancy; restore touches its private staging copy and new destination rather than probing the old source dataset.
Unprovable receipt ownership, unregistered CAS and unowned staging block preflight before any destructive step; no implicit dataset-wide garbage collection.
Completed cleanup removes full operation replies and keeps only the original purge key/request hash and a minimal completed tombstone for exact replay.

full_regression.failures: Three managed sourcePath counterexamples and two backup history compatibility cases repaired; one fake-provider empty-JSON failure passed both isolated original-build and final-build reruns, with root cause unconfirmed.

final_affected_recheck.coverage: Purge request/HTTP/18 process-filesystem cases; management UI; 13 backup-vs-purge state cases; original backup history assertions; backup CLI/restore; data paths; text recovery; real worker lifecycle; native HTTP fixture.

independent_review.acceptance_basis: Unchanged full-regression passing paths reused; all affected paths and original failures covered by final passing recheck.

verified: Empty and incomplete names leave confirmation disabled
Escape returns to retained recycle-bin project
browser.not_executed: Irreversible browser submit; actual request and cleanup are exercised by isolated API/CLI tests

deferred: Diagnose intermittent empty-JSON input at the fake provider in native-requests-http.test.mjs:13; two reruns passed without changing that fixture.
limitations: Old binaries must be stopped before upgrading the maintenance protocol.
Cross-host shared datasets, online garbage collection, automatic purge timers and media-level secure erasure are outside this batch.
Pre-existing backups and external copies remain independent of project deletion.
24 full-regression cases were skipped: optional real Docker, compiler isolation and POSIX-only filesystem paths. External model calls were not run.
Unowned resources, ambiguous receipts or a different incomplete fixed purge plan conservatively block cleanup.
